major_components: Primarily calcium carbonate (CaCO3); eggshell membrane contains proteins

potential_products: Calcium-rich material; eggshell-derived catalyst; eggshell-based adsorbent; composite filler

major_components: Collagen/protein-rich material; mineral components also present depending on species and processing
